rows.source: the object's own enum items: NA|OK|Warning|Error (EVS Neuron shelf, read 2026-09-23). The device grades itself; this row only maps its words onto the ladder.

the object's own enum items: NA|OK. A shelf built with two supplies runs on one when this goes NA.
the object's own enum items: NA|OK|Error|Warning, one per fan in the supply
the object declares its own range: -40..140 C

the object declares its own range: -40..140 C. Outside it the reading is not valid. The plant's own warning points are a site decision — add them with `alarm set --path '**.PSU.*.Temperature' --high minor:R/C,major:R/C`.
the object declares 0..100 %: at 100 the fan has no headroom left, whatever the cause
the object declares 0..250 W as its range
